newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss May inflation rises to 0.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss May inflation rises to 0.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Swiss consumer prices fell 0.3 percent in May from April for a year-on-year inflation rate of 0.6 percent, the Federal Statistics Office said.
Monthly CPI index change -0.3 pct +0.1 pct -0.4 pct

The Swiss statistics office said that the decrease in prices in May versus April were tied to declines in prices in the category for "other goods and services," which was influenced by seasonal declines in prices of package tours.
Prices for transportation and communication, as well as for housing rental and energy were also lower.
Prices rose in the categories clothing and shoes, as well as in foodstuffs, beverages and tobacco goods.
The prices of domestic goods fell by 0.2 percent in May compared with April. Imported goods prices fell by 0.7 percent.
On a yearly basis, domestic goods prices rose on average by 0.6 percent, while those of imported goods rose 0.5 percent. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
